interpretation.measure: House edge is measured against the original bet: with 1% taken on every step, a round of n paid steps returns 0.99^n of the bet on average, before caps and rounding. With 1% taken once it returns 0.99 at any length.
interpretation.once_only_comparator: For a winning 49-call path, reduction relative to the once-only 99% model is 1-0.99^48, approximately 38.27%, not 38.89%. The 38.89% cumulative edge includes the original 1%.
interpretation.49_call_limit: All 20 receipt payloads declare 50 allowed cards and show one starting deal. A synthetic history with one deal and 49 calls contains 50 cards. No captured backend enforcement proves 49 is the maximum number of paid calls or that this precise history was accepted in production.
interpretation.caps: Synthetic path below both current caps demonstrates that those caps need not mathematically bind every 49-call outcome path. It does not establish actual RTP of a strategy subject to forced cashouts, caps, rounding or unavailable actions.
interpretation.probability: At each paid decision, conditional win probability times repeated incremental payout equals 0.99. With a fixed number of paid calls and no cap/rounding interventions, repeated conditional expectation yields 0.99^n. No statistical RNG/distribution test is performed.
interpretation.historical_limits: November 22 public settings are used only to check the displayed current caps. Their unchanged historical application is not proven. Historical receipt fields were collected on 23 November 2026, after the bets.

synthetic49_call_example.evidence_type: Constructed mathematics, not a captured or live bet.
